description: Retrieve the original source media file of an already-analyzed job by generating a presigned download URL for it. This only fetches existing media identified by mediaId — it does not upload files or start any analysis (use echosaw_analyze_media or echosaw_analyze_media_url to begin an analysis). The URL is valid for 1 hour.

mediaId.description: The mediaId of the media to download

name: echosaw_download_media
